name: Cimmerian-Transept

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Descendants of a crashed generation ship, their iron-age rites center the hull that never flew again.

description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a tidally locked hemisphere, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
the automated beacon of unknown purpose was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
